Properties.Description: CoderHelm updates: release checks, notices, auto-update, history

commands: [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]] || { echo "VERSION=$VERSION is not a release tag"; exit 1; }
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -C /tmp/ch-tag init -q --bare

env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -C /tmp/ch-tag fetch -q --no-tags --filter=tree:0 https://github.com/CoderHelm/coderhelm-platform.git "+refs/tags/$VERSION:refs/tags/$VERSION" "+refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main"
[ "$(env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -C /tmp/ch-tag cat-file -t "refs/tags/$VERSION")" = tag ] || { echo "$VERSION is not an annotated tag"; exit 1; }
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -C /tmp/ch-tag cat-file tag "refs/tags/$VERSION" > /tmp/ch-tag.tag
[ "$(sed -n '/^$/q;s/^tag //p' /tmp/ch-tag.tag)" = "$VERSION" ] || { echo "the tag object under $VERSION is named for another version"; exit 1; }
[ "$(sed -n '/^$/q;s/^type //p' /tmp/ch-tag.tag)" = commit ] || { echo "$VERSION does not point to a commit"; exit 1; }
COMMIT=$(env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -C /tmp/ch-tag rev-parse --verify "refs/tags/$VERSION^{commit}")

[[ "$COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] && env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -C /tmp/ch-tag merge-base --is-ancestor "$COMMIT" refs/heads/main || { echo "$VERSION ($COMMIT) is not on main"; exit 1; }

if grep -qxF -e '-----BEGIN SSH SIGNATURE-----' /tmp/ch-tag.tag; then [ "$(grep -cxF -e '-----BEGIN SSH SIGNATURE-----' /tmp/ch-tag.tag)" = 1 ] || { echo "$VERSION has more than one SSH signature"; exit 1; }; env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -C /tmp/ch-tag -c gpg.format=ssh -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile=/tmp/ch-tag.signers -c gpg.ssh.program=ssh-keygen verify-tag "refs/tags/$VERSION" || { echo "$VERSION is not signed by a CoderHelm maintainer key (selfhost/maintainers.json)"; exit 1; }; echo "$VERSION is signed by a maintainer key"; else [ "$(grep -cxF -e '-----BEGIN CODERHELM RELEASE ATTESTATION-----' /tmp/ch-tag.tag)" = 1 ] && [ "$(grep -cxF -e '-----END CODERHELM RELEASE ATTESTATION-----' /tmp/ch-tag.tag)" = 1 ] || { echo "$VERSION has no SSH signature and no release attestation"; exit 1; }; sed -n '/^-----BEGIN CODERHELM RELEASE ATTESTATION-----$/,/^-----END CODERHELM RELEASE ATTESTATION-----$/p' /tmp/ch-tag.tag | sed '1d;$d' | base64 -d > /tmp/ch-tag.bundle || { echo "$VERSION's release attestation is not base64"; exit 1; }; printf 'coderhelm-release-tag v1
repository %s
tag %s
commit %s
' CoderHelm/coderhelm-platform "$VERSION" "$COMMIT" > /tmp/ch-tag.statement; cosign verify-blob --bundle /tmp/ch-tag.bundle --certificate-identity "https://github.com/CoderHelm/coderhelm-platform/.github/workflows/auto-release.yml@refs/heads/main" --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com --certificate-github-workflow-repository CoderHelm/coderhelm-platform --certificate-github-workflow-ref refs/heads/main --certificate-github-workflow-sha "$COMMIT" /tmp/ch-tag.statement || { echo "$VERSION's release attestation is not from auto-release.yml on main for this tag and commit"; exit 1; }; echo "$VERSION was released by auto-release.yml on main"; fi

if grep -q ' models.json$' SHA256SUMS; then curl --proto =https --proto-redir =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o models.json "$B/models.json"; grep ' models.json$' SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c -; node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({status:"verified",manifest:JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("models.json","utf8"))}))' > /tmp/result.json; else echo '{"status":"verified","manifest":null}' > /tmp/result.json; fi
if [ "${CODEBUILD_BUILD_SUCCEEDING:-0}" != "1" ] || [ ! -s /tmp/result.json ]; then echo '{"status":"failed","reason":"the release check failed: see its log"}' > /tmp/result.json; fi
aws lambda invoke --function-name coderhelm-prod-updater --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out --payload file:///tmp/payload.json /tmp/out.json

tag %s
commit %s

if [ "$MODE" = "domain" ]; then coderhelm-selfhost domain apply --yes --require-signature --version "$VERSION" --action "${DOMAIN_ACTION:-attach}" --hostname "${DOMAIN_HOSTNAME:-}" --certificate-arn "${DOMAIN_CERT:-}" --zone "${DOMAIN_ZONE:-}" --zone-id "${DOMAIN_ZONE_ID:-}" --result-file /tmp/result.json; else coderhelm-selfhost update --to "$VERSION" --yes --require-signature --auto-rollback --actor "$ACTOR" --result-file /tmp/result.json $EXTRA; fi
if [ ! -s /tmp/result.json ]; then echo "{\"status\":\"failed\",\"reason\":\"the update build stopped before deploying: see its log\"}" > /tmp/result.json; fi
aws lambda invoke --function-name coderhelm-prod-updater --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out --payload file:///tmp/payload.json /tmp/out.json
